recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中散在三顆淋巴球，體積較一般小淋巴球大、淡藍細胞質較多，其中一顆邊緣被紅血球擠壓呈扇貝狀，符合傳染性單核球增多症的反應性淋巴球。
features: Three lymphocytes larger than typical small lymphocytes
Moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm, with scalloping around adjacent red cells in one cell
Round to oval nuclei with condensed chromatin; no nucleoli seen at this magnification
Normocytic, normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-medium power shows several enlarged lymphocytes with increased pale blue cytoplasm, one of which indents around adjacent red cells. Nuclei are round to oval without evident nucleoli. Red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with reactive lymphocytes, as seen in infectious mononucleosis; the degree of lymphocytosis cannot be judged from a single field.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are small, monotonous with scant cytoplasm and clumped chromatin, often with smudge cells, rather than large cells with abundant scalloped cytoplasm.
Blasts show fine chromatin, nucleoli and high N:C ratio, features absent here.
Monocytes have folded nuclei and grey vacuolated cytoplasm rather than clear blue cytoplasm hugging red cells.
